title: AI/ML Evaluation Gate (CreditFlow model quality + MAIA RAG)

8B_maia_rag_quality.blocking_scope: retrieval + citation validity only. Abstention and generation quality are NOT covered — see abstention.status and open_gaps.

8B_maia_abstention.canonical_claim: For labeled unanswerable queries, MAIA's evidence gate routes the request to an abstention path instead of authorizing an unsupported answer.
8B_maia_abstention.explicitly_not_claimed: This gate does NOT establish that MAIA never hallucinates. A finite labeled set cannot prove a universal claim, and no test here attempts to.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: CI exits non-zero on CreditFlow quality failure
CI exits non-zero on MAIA retrieval failure
acceptance_matrix.detail: gate-decision exit!=0; full-harness exit on bad candidate=1
second retrieval pass produced identical recall/mrr/citation set

acceptance_matrix.requirement: MAIA citation validity: no fabricated chunk ids
MAIA abstention routes labeled no-answer queries
acceptance_matrix.detail: status=FAIL: 1/9 no-answer queries abstained, and generation was entered 8 time(s) on the real production path. No-answer max top_dense=0.6957 overlaps answerable min=0.314, so no SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD value separates the two classes. Measured defect, not an unrun check.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: MAIA answerability oracle validates the no-answer dataset
acceptance_matrix.detail: 7 NO_SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT / OUT_OF_SCOPE rows verified absent from the corpus by token-sequence search; 2 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE rows intentionally present. A mislabelled row would be INVALID_GOLDEN_ROW.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: MAIA abstention negative controls are not no-ops
acceptance_matrix.detail: lowered threshold 0.3->0.01 authorized 9/9 no-answer queries; a deliberately mislabelled row was rejected by the oracle. Both the gate and the dataset check are proven capable of failing.
tenant A querying tenant B's compensation retrieved 0 tenant-B chunks. An answer that is factually true but sourced from another tenant is a security failure, and is scored as one.

open_gaps: MAIA abstention routes labeled no-answer queries
interpretation: Retrieval regression detection and citation validity are verified in 8A/8B, with negative candidates rejected and CI exit codes confirmed. Gate 8 is PARTIAL, and the remaining gap is now a MEASURED DEFECT rather than an unrun check: MAIA's evidence gate authorizes 8 of 9 labeled no-answer queries on the production path. The no-answer and answerable similarity distributions overlap (0.6957 vs 0.3140), so no value of SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD can separate them, which means the gate measures topical similarity rather than answerability. The answerability oracle, the negative controls and the cross-tenant refusal check all PASS, so the failure is a product limitation and not a suspect test. Closing it needs a different decision signal (answer-span verification or an NLI entailment check), not threshold tuning.
